arxiv-1903-02189.title: Grid-Connected Emergency Back-Up Power Supply
arxiv-1903-02189.creator: Dhiman Chowdhury, Mohammad Sharif Miah, Md. Feroz Hossain, Md. Mostafijur Rahman, Md. Marzan Hossain, Md. Nazim Uddin Sheikh, Md. Mehedi Hasan, Uzzal Sarker, Abu Shahir Md. Khalid Hasan
arxiv-1903-02189.description: Abstract This paper documents a design and modelling of a grid-connected emergency back-up power supply for medium power applications. There are a rectifier-link boost derived battery charging circuit and a 4-switch push-pull power inverter circuit which are controlled by pulse width modulation (PWM) signals.

arxiv-2109-00719.title: Multi-agent Bayesian Learning with Best Response Dynamics: Convergence and Stability Thanks: This version: August, 2021.
arxiv-2109-00719.creator: Manxi Wu, Saurabh Amin, Asuman Ozdaglar
arxiv-2109-00719.description: Abstract We study learning dynamics induced by strategic agents who repeatedly play a game with an unknown payoff-relevant parameter. In this dynamics, a belief estimate of the parameter is repeatedly updated given players’ strategies and realized payoffs using Bayes’s rule. Players adjust their strategies by accounting for best response strategies given the belief.

arxiv-2310-10141.title: A Search for Prompts: Generating Structured Answers from Contracts
arxiv-2310-10141.creator: Adam Roegiest, Radha Chitta, Jonathan Donnelly, Maya Lash, Alexandra Vtyurina, François Longtin
arxiv-2310-10141.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Adam Roegiest, Radha Chitta, Jonathan Donnelly, Maya Lash, Alexandra Vtyurina, François Longtin. In many legal processes being able to action on the concrete implication of a legal question can be valuable to automating human review or signalling certain conditions (e.g., alerts around automatic renewal). To support such tasks, we present a form of legal question answering that seeks to return one (or more) fixed answers for a question about a contract clause.

pmc-10520673.title: Primary synovial chondromatosis of the shoulder followed for 11 years after arthroscopic surgery: A case report
pmc-10520673.creator: Tomohiro Kakichi, Hiroki Funasaki, Kota Tanaka, Soki Kato, Mitsuru Saito
pmc-10520673.description: We report a case of primary synovial chondromatosis of the shoulder (Milgram classification, stage III) in a 25-year-old woman. She underwent arthroscopic removal of multiple loose bodies and partial synovectomy. Histological findings revealed primary synovial chondromatosis. Eleven years after surgery, the clinical results have been excellent with no recurrence, although X-ray showed slight degenerative changes of the glenohumeral joint.

pmc-10673070.title: A Robust Memristor-Enhanced Polynomial Hyper-Chaotic Map and Its Multi-Channel Image Encryption Application
pmc-10673070.creator: Kun Qian, Yang Xiao, Yinjie Wei, Di Liu, Quanwen Wang, Wei Feng, Shubhro Chakrabartty, Alaaddin Al-Shidaifat, Sachin Kumar
pmc-10673070.description: Nowadays, the utilization of memristors to enhance the dynamical properties of chaotic systems has become a popular research topic. In this paper, we present the design of a novel 2D memristor-enhanced polynomial hyper-chaotic map (2D-MPHM) by utilizing the cross-coupling of two TiO2 memristors. The dynamical properties of the 2D-MPHM were investigated using Lyapunov exponents, bifurcation diagrams, and trajectory diagrams.

pmc-11439260.title: The role of transformational leadership in the associations between coach-athlete relationship and team resilience: A study on elite football players
pmc-11439260.creator: Erkan Karayel, Ilhan Adilogullari, Ender Senel
pmc-11439260.description: This study explores the relationship between the quality of coach-athlete relationships, transformational leadership style, and team resilience in elite football players. The coach-athlete relationship is an essential factor affecting many performance-related properties of athletes, such as mental health, psychological needs, motivation, and resilience. The study examines how the quality of coach-athlete relationships explains the team resilience feature through transformational leadership.

pmc-11594994.title: Knockout of OsGAPDHC7 Gene Encoding Cytosolic Glyceraldehyde-3-Phosphate Dehydrogenase Affects Energy Metabolism in Rice Seeds
pmc-11594994.creator: Jin-Young Kim, Ye-Ji Lee, Hyo-Ju Lee, Ji-Yun Go, Hye-Mi Lee, Jin-Shil Park, Yong-Gu Cho, Yu-Jin Jung, Kwon-Kyoo Kang, Shu Yuan
pmc-11594994.description: Glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase (GAPDH) is a major glycolytic enzyme that plays an important role in several cellular processes, including plant hormone signaling, plant development, and transcriptional regulation. In this study, we divided it into four groups through structural analysis of eight GAPDH genes identified in the rice genome.

pmc-11598183.title: PM2.5 Exposure as a Risk Factor for Optic Nerve Health in Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
pmc-11598183.creator: Tianyi Yuan, Minna Cheng, Yingyan Ma, Haidong Zou, Haidong Kan, Xia Meng, Yi Guo, Ziwei Peng, Yi Xu, Lina Lu, Saiguang Ling, Zhou Dong, Yuheng Wang, Qinping Yang, Wenli Xu, Yan Shi, Cong Liu, Senlin Lin, Luis Alberto Henríquez-Hernández
pmc-11598183.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). (1) Objective: This study investigated the relationship between long-term particulate matter (PM2.5) exposure and optic disc parameters—vertical cup-to-disc ratio (vCDR), vertical optic disc diameter (vDD), and vertical optic cup diameter (vCD)—in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). (2) Methods: A cross-sectional analysis was conducted using data from 65,750 T2DM patients in the 2017–2018 Shanghai Cohort Study of Diabetic Eye Disease (SCODE).

pmc-12635210.title: 3D multiparametric ultrasound imaging of steatotic liver disease in a study with male rats
pmc-12635210.creator: Donghyun Lee, Jinseok Heo, Hyeonji Mun, Donghyeon Oh, Yongjoo Ahn, Chulhong Kim
pmc-12635210.description: Steatotic liver disease (SLD) is the most prevalent chronic liver disease worldwide, requiring precise diagnosis and ongoing monitoring. Ultrasound imaging (USI) is widely used to diagnose steatosis, but it suffers from limited sensitivity/specificity and/or high observer variability. Assessment of hepatic vascular changes during SLD progression has diagnostic relevance because steatosis can induce sinusoidal microvascular dysfunction.

pmc-12879469.title: Psychosocial correlates of co-workers’ responses to alcohol problems in the workplace - a cross-sectional survey among medical personnel in Poland
pmc-12879469.creator: Justyna Klingemann, Harald Klingemann, Agnieszka Borowiec, Halina Sienkiewicz-Jarosz
pmc-12879469.description: BackgroundThe health of medical staff impacts the quality of patient care. Work-related alcohol issues are in this regard well-documented, linking consumption to adverse outcomes. However, healthcare workers’ responses to perceived alcohol problems, which are crucial for Employee Assistance Programs (EAPs) success, remain under-researched.MethodsThe study surveyed 655 Polish healthcare workers in autumn 2024 by computer assisted personal interviewing (CAPI).

pmc-12912335.title: Using proteomics to identify the mechanisms underlying the benefits of statins on ischemic heart disease
pmc-12912335.creator: Jie V. Zhao, Junmeng Zhang
pmc-12912335.description: Ischemic heart disease (IHD) is the single leading cause of mortality globally. Statins are the mainstay for IHD treatment. However, the specific mechanisms underlying statins’ benefits on IHD have not been clarified. To examine the mechanisms through proteins, we used two-step Mendelian randomization (MR) approach.

pmc-13173230.title: 122 Statistically valid machine learning fairness evaluation
pmc-13173230.creator: Momin Malik, Dave Watson, Madison J Beenken, Chung-Il Wi, Young J Juhn
pmc-13173230.description: Objectives/Goals: Within the machine learning “fairness” literature, models audits are point estimates, and only effect size is considered. The well-developed frameworks in biostatistics for diagnostic testing apply directly to classifiers more generally; these principles can be extended to have statistically valid fairness audits.

pmc-13552693.creator: Chang-Seop Hyun, Mi-Ji Park, Eun-Jeong Jang, An-Na Kim, Seong-Ho Yang, Yong-Soo Hur, Yeong-Je Gang, Jin-Ho Lim
pmc-13552693.description: .5653/cerm.2025.08228 Concerns have been raised regarding the concentration of platelet-rich plasma (PRP) presented in the above article.
